title: Scope: manage keys and secrets from an admin Configuration page instead of GitHub secrets
note: SCOPE ONLY first. Admin tab, Configuration page, sectioned by function (brokers together, one card per account; data vendors; LLM and infra), values masked with reveal-to-see and rotate. Must answer where secrets live (VM vault or encrypted store vs GitHub Actions secrets), how workflows that use Actions secrets keep working, the auth required to reveal (depends on UI-OAUTH-SIGNIN), audit log, threat model of a browser-reachable secret store vs the current setup. Tier 2/3: no build before operator sign-off on the design (operator 2026-11-11 ~08:15Z, queued for after the 17:59Z reset) RESCOPED 2026-11-11 ~09:10Z (operator: do not move secrets into the UI if it is less safe than GitHub; open to other ways to improve control). Facts: Actions secrets are encrypted and never visible in the public repo; runtime keys already live in the VM .env, pushed there by sync-vm-secrets.yml, and rotate-account-keys.yml exists. New scope: (1) Admin > Configuration page, sectioned by function, one card per account, showing NAMES and metadata only: where each key is stored, which services use it, last rotated, a live 'key works' check, permissions summary (trade-only, withdrawals off, IP allowlist) — never values, no reveal. (2) Rotation: the operator pastes the new value in GitHub's secret page (or the broker's), then one click runs the existing sync/rotate workflow and the page shows the verified result. (3) Hardening checks go to SECURITY-HARDENING-AUDIT: VM .env permissions, every exchange key withdraw-disabled and IP-allowlisted to the VM egress IP, separate keys per account, rotation reminders. A reveal-values UI is dropped unless the operator asks again after reading the threat model.
